name: arenax
description: ArenaX Sports Hub - one-command runner (backend + frontend together)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c yellow,cyan "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
